metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins by brennacodes

plugins.name: i-did-a-thing
plugins.description: A build-me-up tool that helps you log professional experiences and build tailored resumes from your personal arsenal of evidence

plugins.name: what-did-you-do
plugins.description: Interview preparation with persona-driven practice, company-specific mocks, spaced repetition, and progress tracking — powered by your i-did-a-thing arsenal

plugins.name: mark-my-words
plugins.description: Write, manage, and publish blog posts on any markdown-based platform — Quartz, Hugo, Jekyll, Astro, Eleventy, Docusaurus, and Zola

plugins.name: what-do-you-know
plugins.description: Deepen your understanding of topics through concept quizzing, knowledge gap analysis, and personalized learning plans — powered by your i-did-a-thing arsenal

plugins.name: screenshotr
plugins.description: Precise screenshot capabilities for macOS — capture screens, windows, regions, or URLs with resize, crop, delay, and format control

plugins.name: things
plugins.description: Schema-aware data layer for .things/ - manages setup, git sync, search, validation, collection registration, and central tag indexing for all brenna-plugs plugins

plugins.name: think-like
plugins.description: Apply expert thinking profiles to code reviews, architecture evaluation, and security audits - think like DHH, Sandi Metz, or build your own expert profiles

plugins.name: heres-the-thing
plugins.description: Persuasion and positioning engine -- take any subject, tailor it for any audience, in any medium, and track what works

plugins.name: session-scout
plugins.description: A tool to help you grep through your Claude Code session data, list active sessions, and resume where you left off

plugins.name: for-the-record
plugins.description: Capture structured documentation from Claude conversations — decisions, technical references, discussion summaries, how-to guides, and architecture docs with auto-tagging and search

plugins.name: playbook
plugins.description: Orchestrate plans, workflows, implementation tracking, and reviews — import plans from Claude sessions, create XML-enhanced workflows, review implementations, and track progress

plugins.name: claude-scout
plugins.description: Track filesystem changes in ~/.claude/ and other directories — git snapshots, changelog parsing, diff queries, and plugin dependency health checks
